items.label: RISK-OFF — Iran Day 14, WTI $98.71, VIX 27.19
items.detail: RISK-OFF confirmed heading into FOMC week (Mar 15): VIX 27.19, SPX 6,632 (-0.61%, 3rd consecutive weekly loss). WTI Crude $98.71 (+3.11%), Brent $98.91 (+2.36%). US-Iran conflict day 14. DXY 100.50. Gold $5,061/oz. BTC $71,514. Fear & Greed 22 (Extreme Fear). Regime score 0.443.

items.label: Iran War Day 13 — Hormuz Closure Confirmed
items.detail: Iran's new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei (appointed March 9) reaffirmed Strait of Hormuz closure. The waterway handles ~20% of global oil trade. Brent $100.46, WTI $95.73. Airlines and consumer stocks tumble. Escalation = oil $120+. Ceasefire/reopening = oil drops to $68-72.

items.label: CPI February — SHOCK +3.1% YoY — Stagflation Confirmed
items.detail: February CPI printed +0.4% MoM / +3.1% YoY — hottest since June 2023, crushing +2.9% consensus. Core CPI +0.4% MoM. Stagflation officially confirmed: high inflation + weakening payrolls + oil shock. Fed completely paralyzed ahead of FOMC March 18-19. VIX spiked to 29.4 on the print.

items.label: ADBE Earnings Miss — AI Disruption, Goldman Sell $220
items.detail: Adobe crashed -15% Friday on Q1 earnings miss and guidance cut. Goldman Sachs initiated at Sell with $220 target (vs ~$350 prior close). Morgan Stanley, Barclays, Mizuho, KeyCorp all slashed targets. AI commoditizing creative software. Risk of contagion to CRM, NOW, MSFT on Monday.

items.label: Recession Odds 32% — Polymarket Alarm
items.detail: US recession probability jumped to 32% on Polymarket following Hormuz closure and oil shock. Oil supply disruption historically precedes recession in 6-12 months. Energy costs are a tax on growth. Fed trapped: can't cut if oil drives inflation, but economy needs relief.

items.label: FOMC March 18 — Dot Plot + Powell Presser Critical
items.detail: FOMC decision Wednesday March 18 at 2:00 PM ET. Hold at 3.50-3.75% priced at 92%. The Dot Plot update is the critical variable: a median 2026 rate above 3.75% signals stagflation in Fed's base case. Powell presser at 2:30 PM — term expires May 23, every word amplified. Monthly OpEx on March 20 adds gamma risk.

items.label: Oil Surge — Brent $103.86, WTI $99.31 (+3.74%)
items.detail: Brent crude at $103.86/bbl (+3.38%), WTI $99.31 (+3.74%). Iran Hormuz closure is now the market's baseline. Trump warning Iran of 'hard hit' amplified the move. Energy (XOM $156.12 +1.69%, COP $121.89 +1.36%, DVN $46.25 +0.65%) structural longs. XLE ETF +0.33%, only green sector on the day.

items.label: Trade War — April 2 USMCA Deadline Approaching
items.detail: Canada/Mexico USMCA exemptions expire April 2. SCOTUS IEEPA ruling created legal uncertainty on tariff enforcement. US-China tariffs at 30%/10% but implementation unclear. April 2 = next major flashpoint.

items.label: New Iran Supreme Leader — Mojtaba Khamenei
items.detail: Mojtaba Khamenei appointed as new Supreme Leader of Iran (March 9). His first major act: reaffirm Hormuz closure. Hawkish posture more extreme than predecessor. Changes US-Iran negotiation dynamics significantly — diplomatic resolution now harder.

items.label: DXY 100.50 — EUR/USD 1.1423, ECB-Fed Divergence
items.detail: DXY at 100.50 (+0.13%). EUR/USD at 1.1423 (-0.81%) as ECB-Fed divergence trade builds. ECB may need to cut while Fed holds due to stagflation. Break of 1.13 would signal ECB cut before Fed, destabilizing for European equities. USD remains safe-haven bid in risk-off.

items.label: S&P 500 — 3rd Weekly Loss, Closing at 6,632
items.detail: S&P 500 closed Friday at 6,632 (-0.61%, -3rd consecutive weekly loss). Dow -0.26% at 46,558. Nasdaq -0.93% at 22,105. Russell 2000 -0.36%. Only Energy (XLE +0.33%) and Financials (XLF +0.12%) closed green. SPY below 50-day moving average ($686.88). Key support at $640-650 zone.

items.label: XOM — Energy Mega-Cap in Iran War
items.detail: ExxonMobil and major energy names are the only structural longs in RISK-OFF. XOM approaching $157+ with oil at $95+. COP, EQNR, CVX all breaking out. Iran scenario: energy stays elevated for weeks/months if Hormuz closed. Entry on pullbacks to $152-154, TP $168.

items.label: LMT/RTX — Defense Bid Intensifies
items.detail: Lockheed Martin (LMT) +2.1%, Raytheon (RTX) +1.8%, Northrop (NOC) +1.4% as Iran war escalates. NATO spending commitments + Hormuz crisis = multi-year defense capex cycle. LMT targeting $600+.

items.label: Gold $5,100 — Safe Haven Resilient
items.detail: Gold at $5,100 despite DXY reversal higher. Safe haven demand overwhelming dollar headwind. Iran war + recession risk = gold structural support. GLD, GDX (miners) remain core positioning. Watch for acceleration if FOMC turns dovish next week.

items.label: Bitcoin $71,514 — RISK_OFF Resilience + 20M Coin Milestone
items.detail: Bitcoin at $71,514 (Mar 15). BTC dominance 58.16% (BTC Season). Total market cap $2.39T. Fear & Greed 22 (Extreme Fear). BTC holding $70K floor across 3rd consecutive weekly SPX loss — confirmed geopolitical hedge signal. Resistance $73.5K. Support $68K → $65K. FOMC March 18 is binary event.

items.label: BlackRock Staked ETH ETF — Institutional Staking Access Launched
items.detail: BlackRock launched a Staked Ethereum ETF on March 13, 2026 — the first product offering regulated institutional access to ETH staking yield (~3-4% APR). A structural demand catalyst for ETH medium-term. First AUM data this week will be watched closely. ETH trading at $2,108, compressed vs. 2025 highs.

items.label: BTC 20M Coin Mined — Supply Milestone (March 9)
items.detail: Bitcoin's 20 millionth coin was mined on March 9, 2026. Only 1M BTC remain to be mined until the 21M hard cap. This is a major supply narrative milestone reinforcing Bitcoin's digital scarcity thesis. Long-term structural bullish.

items.label: SaaS Carnage — AI Disruption Wave
items.detail: INTU -32% YTD, CRM -28%, NOW -25%. Software sector repricing continues as AI commoditizes traditional SaaS. DOCU an exception (+6.8% on earnings) proving AI can be additive. Sector rotation out of tech ongoing.

items.label: OpEx Friday March 20 — FOMC Volatility
items.detail: Monthly options expiration on March 20 coincides with FOMC week. Large open interest on SPX puts at 6,400-6,600 strikes. Gamma effects could amplify market moves in either direction. High-risk week for volatility.

items.label: EU Fiscal Expansion — Structural Tailwind
items.detail: Germany EUR 500B infrastructure fund + EU defense spending continuing. DAX more resilient than US peers (energy/defense heavy vs. tech-heavy). EUR/USD under pressure from DXY reversal but EU structural story intact.

items.label: US Debt Ceiling — Late Q2 2026
items.detail: Treasury extraordinary measures expected to run out by June-July 2026. Political brinkmanship risk. Credit downgrade potential. Oil shock + recession risk adds fiscal pressure.

items.label: US Midterm Elections — November 2026
items.detail: Congressional midterms in November 2026. Historical pattern: markets rally post-midterms. Pre-election volatility typically begins Q3. Iran war + recession risk could reshape political dynamics.
